hazards.evidence: Pet bed, food bowl, and a bone/toy on the carpet plus a wooden chair sitting right at the bedside create clutter around the bed.
A wooden chair is placed in the narrow gap alongside the bed, blocking the space a walker would need to pass/transfer.
A loose mat/throw rug over the carpet at the foot/side of the bed, partially under the chair legs, in the walking area.
Chair and pet items sit in the path between the doorway and the bed, narrowing the walker route.
Wooden side chair with no armrests (harder to sit/stand after hip/knee replacement) placed in the room.
Pet items underfoot: dog bed, filled food bowl, and a chew bone/toy on the floor beside the bed.
